summary: The Stage 1 retry waits, with a deadline, until a new workspace grants the deployer SQL access.
prompt: On a greenfield run, Stage 1 creates the Databricks workspace and then the foundation apply fails creating the SQL warehouse because the deployer lacks databricks-sql-access. The automatic retry fails the same way seconds later. In a new workspace the admins group receives SQL access a few minutes after creation. Make the Stage 1 retry succeed without operator intervention, with a bounded wait.
